hubFaqPairs.question: Should I depart from Bali or Surabaya?
hubFaqPairs.answer: Surabaya is the default starting point — direct overland access to Bromo (~3 hrs) and Ijen (~5 hrs) with no ferry. Bali departures add the Gilimanuk–Ketapang ferry (45 min each way) plus 1–2 extra hours overland; choose Bali only if you are already vacationing there. Both options run on JVTO private vehicles with no shared transport at any point.

hubFaqPairs.question: Which tours include Ijen Blue Fire vs Bromo only?
hubFaqPairs.answer: Bromo-only tours are the 1D1N and 2D1N options — no health screening required. Ijen tours start at 2D1N and trigger the BBKSDA SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024 health screening protocol coordinated by JVTO with Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu, conducted at the guest's hotel in Bondowoso. The 3D2N and longer routes typically combine both volcanoes plus Madakaripura or Tumpak Sewu waterfalls.

hubFaqPairs.question: What is the shortest and longest tour available?
hubFaqPairs.answer: Shortest: 1-day Bromo Sunrise (bromo-1d1n) — midnight pickup, return same evening. Longest: 6-day full East Java circuit covering Ijen + Papuma Beach + Tumpak Sewu + Bromo + Malang. The 3D2N format is the most-booked balance of coverage and pace; 4D3N adds either rest time or a waterfall extension.
